Title: Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 Wire to Wire Connector System, single row tin plating

Section 4.2 rated current and applicable wires:
AWG22 3.4 A
AWG24 3.0 A
AWG26 2.6 A
Section 4.3 reference derating, 2 circuits: AWG22 4.7 A; AWG24 3.9 A; AWG26 2.9 A. Reference values only; AQROOT uses section 4.2 rated current, not the derating reference value.
Section 4.4 ambient range: -40 C to +105 C, including terminal temperature rise.
Section 6.1.5 temperature rise at maximum rated current: 30 C MAX.
Section 6.2.2 crimp pull-out: AWG22 39.2 N MIN; AWG24 29.4 N MIN; AWG26 19.6 N MIN.
Series identities: receptacle terminal 505572; receptacle housing 505570; plug terminal 213720; plug housing 213719.
